request.user_excerpt:
Speaker: Jensen Huang
Host (never attribute their words to the speaker): Chamath Palihapitiya, Jason Calacanis, David Sacks, David Friedberg
Source: "Jensen Huang: The Doomer Hoax, Superintelligence i

claims.quote:
The world needs both closed models and
open models.
claims.claim: Jensen Huang believes the world needs both closed AI models and open AI models.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Jensen Huang continues to publicly say or act consistently with the view that both closed AI models and open AI models are needed.

claims.quote:
The facts are in the last 6 months
$400 billion of venture funding went
into AI native companies.
80% of them use open models.
claims.claim: In the six months before September 14, 2026, $400 billion of venture funding went into AI-native companies.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Venture funding databases or credible industry reports show that AI-native companies received about $400 billion in venture funding during the six months before September 14, 2026.

claims.quote:
The facts are in the last 6 months
$400 billion of venture funding went
into AI native companies.
80% of them use open models.
claims.claim: Eighty percent of the AI-native companies that received venture funding in the six months before September 14, 2026 use open models.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Venture funding databases, company disclosures, or credible industry reports show that about 80% of the AI-native companies funded during the six months before September 14, 2026 use open models.

claims.quote:
probably the vast majority of the
world's contribution to open source
today is coming from China.
claims.claim: As of September 14, 2026, the vast majority of the world's contribution to open source is coming from China.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Public open-source contribution data or credible analyses show that China accounts for a majority of global open-source contributions as of September 14, 2026.

claims.quote:
My point is the race is really
about who exploits the technology best.
claims.claim: Jensen Huang believes the AI race is about who exploits AI technology best.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Jensen Huang continues to publicly characterize the AI race as primarily about who best exploits or applies AI technology.
